description: Classification of all 770 EL checklist items by distance-measurement applicability. Covers all 20 EL guide files.

categories.horizontal: Requires plan-view distance measurement — tool CAN measure
categories.vertical-or-mixed: Requires vertical/3D clearance — tool CANNOT fully measure (yet)

subClassifications.distance-only: Distance measurement alone can resolve the verdict (compare measured value to threshold)
subClassifications.distance-plus: Distance measurement needed but verdict also requires additional information (see additionalRequirements)

additionalRequirementTypes.species-verification: Tree species must be confirmed as utility-compatible or non-compatible per ECM Appendix F
additionalRequirementTypes.material-specification: Construction material type must be verified (non-conductive, fire-rated, etc.)
additionalRequirementTypes.orientation-identification: Equipment access door orientation must be identified on plans
additionalRequirementTypes.equipment-type-identification: Equipment type (oil-filled vs dry-type) must be determined
additionalRequirementTypes.documentation-approval: Written approval from Austin Energy Design is required
additionalRequirementTypes.root-barrier-specification: Root barrier details must be specified (depth, position from equipment)
additionalRequirementTypes.bollard-specification: Bollard details must be specified (diameter, spacing, material)
